value.body: Public-sector undertakings (PSUs) hire for management, HR, finance and marketing roles, but most officer-level openings ask for an MBA/PGDM, CA or CMA rather than a BBA alone. With a BBA, the main public-sector routes are graduate-level exams, such as bank and insurance officer exams, or an MBA followed by PSU management-trainee recruitment.

items.label: Typical officer entry
items.note: Usually needs an MBA/PGDM, CA or CMA

items.label: Recruitment
items.note: Written test, group discussion and/or interview

items.label: Operating central PSUs (CPSEs)
items.note: Out of 448 CPSEs reported by ministries/departments
items.source: Public Enterprises Survey 2023-24, Department of Public Enterprises (as reported)

items.label: BBA enrolment (regular mode)
items.note: All BBA students in India, not only those aiming for PSU jobs

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Any graduate, including a BBA, can sit graduate-level public-sector exams such as bank PO and insurance officer exams. For PSU management-trainee posts, the usual route is an MBA/PGDM in HR, finance or marketing, then applying to each PSU's notice.

value.title: At a glance
items: Each PSU recruits separately and irregularly, so openings vary from year to year.
Some PSUs have shortlisted HR trainees using UGC-NET scores.
Public-sector bank and insurance officer exams are open to any graduate.
PSU jobs come with job security and transfers across the company's locations.
